Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Degree / Diploma (Minimum 3 years duration) in Hotel Management and Catering Technology / Hospitality and Hotel Administration from any Institute affiliated to National Council for Hotel Management and Catering Technology / State Board of Technical Education / Recognized University having minimum 50% marks in aggregate -- with two years of experience in industry or Teaching. OR MA or M. Sc. in Home Science with 55% of marks (in Food and Nutrition / Nutrition and Dietetics / Institutional Management and dietetics or equivalent). OR B.Sc. (Home Science) with one year certificate course in Food and Beverage Service / Food Production with one year experience in relevant trade.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Rs. 400/- per class/lecture of 45 minutes' duration subject to a ceiling of maximum 40 classes with Rs 16,000/- per month.

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for GVHSS Tihidi Guest Faculty in CRM Trade Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://bhadrak.odisha.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 28-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the GVHSS Tihidi Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Guest Faculty in CRM Trade post is 28th September 2026. It is advised to submit the application well before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Faculty in CRM Trade post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Degree/Diploma in Hotel Management and Catering Technology or equivalent, or an MA/M.Sc. in Home Science, or a B.Sc. (Home Science) with a certificate course, along with relevant experience as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Guest Faculty position is 65 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty role?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 400/- per class/lecture of 45 minutes, with a monthly ceiling of Rs. 16,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview and Certificate Verification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Govt Vocational Higher Secondary School (GVHSS Tihidi) located?
faq.answer: The school is located in Bhadrak, Odisha, with the pincode 756130.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 764.

faq.question: Q10. When is the interview and certificate verification scheduled?
faq.answer: The interview and certificate verification will be conducted on 30th September 2026.
